sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The applicability, passenger-only boundary, ship-level boolean cardinality/value check, person relationship, exact-one assignment, and OR equipment logic now preserve the earlier repairs. However, the immersionSuitEquipment and thermalProtectiveAidEquipment class constraints are applied to the assigned equipment node, while both canonical terms declare requiredOwner ship. Do not place these canonical checks on the equipment choice node; encode the alternatives against their authoritative ship owner using an approved path/owner structure, without inventing a ship/component indirection. No vocabulary matcher is needed because all required canonical concepts are already supplied.
